record.segment: Public community college district; Northwest College serves over 9,000 students; Houston, Texas
facts_carried_over: Dr. Ken Tidwell is the new Vice President for Instructional and Student Services at HCC Northwest College; HCC Northwest Magazine, Summer 2026, published 2026-06-29.
Tidwell previously served as Dean for Workforce Development at San Jacinto College; HCC Northwest Magazine, Summer 2026, published 2026-06-29.
Tidwell said colleges must place education into students' lives rather than require students to put their lives on hold; HCC Northwest Magazine, Summer 2026, published 2026-06-29.
HCC Northwest serves over 9,000 students across West Houston and offers courses in more than 60 HCC programs; official HCC Northwest About Us page, accessed 2026-09-15.
HCC FY2025-2026 goals include increasing persistence from 59% to 61%, improving developmental progression by 5%, and growing enrollment; official HCC Institutional Goals page, accessed 2026-09-15.
HCC uses Canvas and a student system; official HCC website, accessed 2026-09-15.

HCC's FY2026 budget identifies Dr. Norma Perez as Senior Vice Chancellor for Instructional and Student Services, Barry Sullivan as CIO, Boni Jacobs as Executive Director of Financial Aid, and Cassaundra Jackson as Executive Director of Enterprise Business Applications; FY2026 Approved Budget, published 2025-10-01.
